name: Bugbear
summary: Hulking, hairy goblinoids who are surprisingly quiet for their size. Bugbears love ambushes and strike from further away than their foes expect.

age.summary: Bugbears mature at 16 and live up to 80 years.

size.description: Bugbears are 6 to 8 feet tall and weigh 250 to 350 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Long-Limbed
features.summary: On your turn, your melee attacks reach 5 feet further than normal.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.summary: You count as one size larger when working out your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag or lift.

features.name: Sneaky
features.summary: You are proficient in the Stealth skill.

features.name: Surprise Attack
features.summary: If you hit a surprised creature on your first turn in combat, it takes an extra 2d6 damage. Once per combat.

action.short: Extra 2d6 damage on a hit against a surprised creature, once per combat.
